lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters posterior to the pectoral fin, arranged in approximately four visible horizontal rows with increasing spacing towards the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows to form a lattice-like structure, most prominent in the mid-lateral section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single continuous horizontal ridge feature is visible in the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp transition from high-intensity pixels on the dorsal side to a low-intensity shadow boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a dark, slender fusiform object, likely a commensal remora, visible in the lower center-right foreground below the mid-lateral line.
